name: word-roller-shuffle
title: Word Roller Shuffle
description: Every letter of a word flickers through random capitals and digits, then locks into its true letter from left to right with a small pop in the accent colour, while a bar below fills as letters are confirmed.
useWhen: A decoding or unlocking reveal of one word, name or code on a clean title.
avoidWhen: The reveal should be smooth rather than noisy: use per-character-rise.
Several words: use scramble-reveal or matrix-decode.
author: lifeprompt-team

variables.label: Lead-in
variables.description: Small caps line above the word.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Size of the letters in pixels. A wide word shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Locked color
variables.description: Color and bar of the confirmed letters.

variables.label: Shuffling color
variables.description: Color of the letters that are still shuffling.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Fill behind the text. Use transparent to lay the block over your own footage.
